summary: Reject: label/dimension/statement-bank cues answer every delivered batch item; a valid one-entry decision change is rejected; two supplied source cases are unsupported. Independent math, native grading, rendering and runtime packaging checks pass. Package unchanged. Existing-pool absence is not verified.

source_analysis.skill: Identify every true triangularity statement by inspecting the correct off-diagonal half of a square matrix, transposing and, for the hard family, adding or subtracting the transpose.
reasoning_steps: Read the matrix and each independently phrased statement.
Form the indicated transpose or sum/difference when applicable.
Upper triangular means every entry strictly below the diagonal is zero; lower means every entry strictly above is zero.
Select all and only true statements; None of the above is true exactly when all substantive statements are false.
invariants: Square matrices; diagonal entries do not determine triangularity.
Retain zero-testing, transpose and observed +/- operations, Boolean select-all response and comparable workload.
Diagonal matrices qualify as both upper and lower; transpose swaps the halves.
permitted_variations: Vary label independently of truth, signed integer entries including diagonal zeros, sparse nonzero positions, and 3x3/4x4 size.
Vary which off-diagonal half has nonzeros: lower-only, upper-only, both, neither. This changes qualifying statements and selection counts and is essential eligible answer-bearing variation.
Vary transpose target upper/lower and statement order independently of label and matrix profile.
Within hard scope vary symmetry/antisymmetry of mirrored entries so sums/differences may cancel or not; do not fix the derived statement true just because a source example does.
source_refs: tutorial 658a47dc-4d32-5d9d-a04c-82d683e87739: upper triangular is square with all entries below the diagonal zero; lower uses above; any number including 0 is allowed on diagonal and other half.
canonical 205d32a2-ac26-5eaf-896a-c6182a70eff7: A lower true, upper and A^T-A lower false.
prerequisite e3d1f202-a3d6-561f-bd4b-3e886142e5a0: interchange rows and columns.

findings.description: Complete answers are predictable from matrix label, dimension and statement wording, without inspecting entries. This succeeds on all 5 exact runner records after actual delivery filtering, as well as all 50 independently seeded controls. For example, every moderate A record selects direct lower and transpose upper; C 3x3 selects all ordinary statements while C 4x4 selects only direct upper. None is always false.

Exact batch seed 4077425948 gives C 3x3, all three ordinary selections; seeds 4077425949 and 4077425952 give A, lower+transpose upper. See shortcut-source-map.json, shortcut-results.json and delivery-batch/accepted.json.
findings.requested_change: Decouple labels, dimensions and statement-bank identity from qualifying roles; vary strict-half zero/nonzero assignments within each recognizable family and derive keys/solutions from the complete instance. Replace the exact delivered batch after repair and retest conditional shortcuts; numerical resampling or choice shuffling alone cannot fix it.

findings.description: The complete-source-bank truth guard rejects valid same-skill decision changes. A single entry a21:1→0 changes lower-only to diagonal, but q-42091 rejects it before prompt/key/solution construction. This enforces an incidental source outcome and prevents meaningful counterfactual grading.

findings.requested_change: Replace family-wide source-truth/zero-region restrictions and source-only support catalogs with constraints on operation, size and workload. Permit diagonal, upper-only, lower-only and neither assignments where meaningful, derive all Boolean decisions and explanations, and handle all-false ordinary sets using the source-backed None option rather than suppressing them. Retain strict relevant/irrelevant tests.
